briefdescription.para: Template class providing a vector indexed by a custom type with bounds checking and Boost.Serialization support.

detaileddescription.para: This class wraps around std::vector and allows indexing using a custom type (IndexType) while enforcing bounds checks. It supports typical vector operations such as push_back, resize, iteration, and access. It also provides a specialization for bool to save memory and behave like std::vector<bool>.
